description: Agent-era pattern file (v0.1). Semantic-first pattern data in JSON: one style + one size per file. Named points/edges/segments replace volatile DXF # numbers; DXF-AAMA stays the production interchange format. Units are cm, coordinates are block-local (the piece's own frame, not modelspace placement).

checks.description: Production pairing checks, e.g. sleeve cap == front armhole + back armhole.

lineage.description: What this version derives from and what changed.

edges.description: Named boundary curves. 'points' are the semantic anchors (start, via, end); 'xy' is the measured net-outline polyline between them.

points.description: Named points, block-local cm [x, y]. Names are stable across versions and replace DXF # numbers. Same geometric point = one name.

sa.description: Seam allowance in cm. 'default' is the general value; named overrides (hem, collar...) replace it on that edge.

segments.description: Named measurements. 'method': outline = along the net outline, straight = straight distance. 'length' is the measured value in cm.

symmetric.description: Left/right are mirror images; define one side only.

outline.description: The complete closed NET outline (layer 14), block-local cm, in order. This is the authoritative geometry: the pattern is regenerated from it. Named edges are sub-arcs of it; straight seams between named points are read off it, never assumed.

pieces.description: Pieces keyed by a stable id (front, back, sleeve, collar...). The id never changes across versions.

size.description: Single size, e.g. M. Grading is a separate concern.

source.description: Where this pattern came from (the DXF it was imported from).

title: apattern
